name: Cherry Japanese House
description: A large japanese house with stacked pink roofs, dark wood framing and a stone stair entrance. Two floors of interior space behind tall windows, with lanterns hung from the eaves. It takes plenty of wood and pink blocks. Suits a temple district or a big cherry build.
